user.title: Connect to Lumo
user.description: Address of your Lumo server and the password of its web UI (not the Schulportal password).

data_description.host: Name or IP address, e.g. lumo.local

accounts.title: Choose children
accounts.description: Which children of this server should appear in Home Assistant?

reauth_confirm.title: Password changed
reauth_confirm.description: The Lumo server at {host} rejected the stored password. Enter the current web UI password.

error.cannot_connect: The server is not reachable. Check host, port and HTTPS.
error.rate_limited: Too many failed logins. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.setup_required: The Lumo server is not set up yet. Finish the setup in its web UI first.
error.not_lumo: This is not a Lumo server (or its version is not supported).
error.no_accounts: The server has no child set up yet. Add one in the Lumo web UI first.

abort.already_configured: This server is already set up.
abort.wrong_server: This is a different server than the configured one. Add it as a new entry instead.

data_description.accounts: Children that appear in Home Assistant.
data_description.enable_grades: Off by default. Grades are personal data: only switch this on if you want them in Home Assistant (history, recorder).
data_description.allow_homework_write: Off by default. Marking homework as done writes to the real Schulportal.
